scores.doc: UC does not use SAT or ACT in admission

testPolicy.text: UC Davis, like every UC campus, does not consider SAT or ACT scores in admission decisions or in awarding Regents and Chancellor's scholarships; scores may be used for the statewide guarantee, minimum eligibility or course placement.
testPolicy.since: test-blind since fall 2023 entry for California applicants, extended to nonresidents (Regents decision of May 21, 2020; UC will not consider SAT or ACT scores in admission decisions or Regents and Chancellor's scholarships)

gpa.doc: CDS not accessible; UC's fall 2026 admit snapshot gives a middle-50% high school GPA of 4.00-4.25 for admits

aidPromise.text: Blue and Gold: most California families earning up to $100,000 receive enough grant and scholarship money to cover UC tuition. Tuition predictability: a UC student's tuition is set at first enrollment and stays the same for up to six years. Blue and Gold applies to California residents only.

deadlines.regular: November 30 (UC application filing period for fall 2027 entry, opens August 1)

facts.text: UC Davis offered fall 2025 first-year admission to a record 45,963 applicants, 10.4% more than the year before, out of 120,131 total applications (first-year and transfer).
For fall 2026 UC Davis admitted 48,015 of 104,864 first-year applicants (preliminary), a 45.8% admit rate, the least selective of the five UC campuses in this set.
International students were 14,009 of UC Davis's 48,015 fall 2026 first-year admits, more than at any other UC campus.
Of the 55,739 students admitted for fall 2025 (first-year and transfer), 34,088 were California residents, 61.1% of the total.
UC guarantees first-year admission to a UC campus, though not necessarily the campus of choice, to California students in the top 9 percent of their high school or of the state.

notes: Every ucdavis.edu host used for data (aggiedata.ucdavis.edu CDS, financialaid.ucdavis.edu cost of attendance, www.ucdavis.edu) returns HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch, so the UC Davis CDS 2025-26 and the 2026-27 cost of attendance could not be opened: cost is null. The fall 2025 release was reachable only at the index%2ephp URL listed in search results. UCOP's Tableau freshman table (UGAdmissionsSummaryDataTable_0, filtered Campus=Davis) sums to 45,673 fall 2025 first-year admits, a later figure than the 45,963 preliminary count; neither gives applicants. Fall 2026 numbers are preliminary. No early plans; one UC application due November 30.
